## 1. Environment Setup and Directories

```{r init}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(reshape2)
library(dplyr)

base_dir <- "MetaGenomics_Dataset"

test_dir <- base_dir
validation_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "validation")

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "results_pipeline")
validation_out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "validation_predictions")

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(validation_out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

```

## 2. Utility Functions

```{r utilities}
read_count_table <- function(path) {
  
  x <- fread(path, data.table = FALSE)
  
  if (!is.numeric(x[[1]])) {
    rownames(x) <- x[[1]]
    x <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  x <- as.data.frame(x)
  x[] <- lapply(x, as.numeric)
  x <- as.matrix(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  
  if (is.null(colnames(x))) {
    colnames(x) <- paste0("TAXA_", seq_len(ncol(x)))
  }
  
  if (is.null(rownames(x))) {
    rownames(x) <- paste0("Sample_", seq_len(nrow(x)))
  }
  
  return(x)
}

read_adj_matrix <- function(path, taxa_names) {
  
  adj <- fread(path, data.table = FALSE)
  
  if (!is.numeric(adj[[1]])) {
    rownames(adj) <- adj[[1]]
    adj <- adj[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  adj <- as.data.frame(adj)
  adj[] <- lapply(adj, as.numeric)
  adj <- as.matrix(adj)
  adj[is.na(adj)] <- 0
  adj[adj != 0] <- 1
  diag(adj) <- 0
  
  if (all(taxa_names %in% rownames(adj)) && all(taxa_names %in% colnames(adj))) {
    adj <- adj[taxa_names, taxa_names, drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    warning("Adjacency names do not match perfectly. Using matrix order.")
    adj <- adj[seq_along(taxa_names), seq_along(taxa_names), drop = FALSE]
    rownames(adj) <- taxa_names
    colnames(adj) <- taxa_names
  }
  
  return(adj)
}
```

## 3. Preprocessing Transformations

Standard transformations applied to handle compositional and zero-inflated metagenomics count data.

```{r preprocessing}
log_transform <- function(x) {
  log1p(x)
}

total_sum_scaling <- function(x) {
  lib_size <- rowSums(x)
  lib_size[lib_size == 0] <- 1
  sweep(x, 1, lib_size, "/") * median(lib_size)
}

zero_imputation_simple <- function(x) {
  positive_min <- min(x[x > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(positive_min)) positive_min <- 1
  x[x == 0] <- positive_min / 2
  return(x)
}

clr_transform <- function(x, pseudo = 1) {
  x <- x + pseudo
  log_x <- log(x)
  sweep(log_x, 1, rowMeans(log_x), "-")
}
```

## 4. Network Inference Models

Generates association score matrices using simple correlation metrics or a ridge-regularized precision matrix approach.

```{r inference-models}
make_correlation_network <- function(x, method = "pearson") {
  
  score <- cor(x, method = method, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  score[is.na(score)] <- 0
  diag(score) <- 0
  
  score <- abs(score)
  return(score)
}

make_precision_network <- function(x) {
  
  x <- scale(x)
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  
  s <- cov(x, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
  s[is.na(s)] <- 0
  
  lambda <- 0.1
  precision <- solve(s + diag(lambda, ncol(s)))
  
  score <- abs(precision)
  diag(score) <- 0
  
  if (max(score) > 0) {
    score <- score / max(score)
  }
  
  return(score)
}

```

## 5. Matrix Thresholding

Converts continuous score matrices into binary adjacency matrices by isolating the top interactions based on desired edge density.

```{r thresholding}
threshold_top_edges <- function(score_mat, edge_density = 0.05) {
  
  n <- ncol(score_mat)
  scores <- score_mat[upper.tri(score_mat)]
  
  k <- max(1, floor(length(scores) * edge_density)) #numero di edges possibili
  cutoff <- sort(scores, decreasing = TRUE)[k]
  
  adj <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
  rownames(adj) <- rownames(score_mat)
  colnames(adj) <- colnames(score_mat)
  
  adj[score_mat >= cutoff] <- 1
  diag(adj) <- 0
  adj[lower.tri(adj)] <- t(adj)[lower.tri(adj)]
  
  return(adj)
}
```

## 6. Evaluation Metrics

Calculates AUROC and AUPRC to evaluate the inferred networks against the gold standard.

```{r metrics}
compute_auroc <- function(labels, scores) {
  
  labels <- as.numeric(labels)
  scores <- as.numeric(scores)
  
  pos <- sum(labels == 1)
  neg <- sum(labels == 0)
  
  if (pos == 0 || neg == 0) return(NA)
  
  ranks <- rank(scores)
  auroc <- (sum(ranks[labels == 1]) - pos * (pos + 1) / 2) / (pos * neg)
  
  return(auroc)
}

compute_auprc <- function(labels, scores) {
  
  labels <- as.numeric(labels)
  scores <- as.numeric(scores)
  
  if (sum(labels == 1) == 0) return(NA)
  
  ord <- order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)
  labels <- labels[ord]
  
  tp <- cumsum(labels == 1)
  fp <- cumsum(labels == 0)
  
  precision <- tp / (tp + fp)
  recall <- tp / sum(labels == 1)
  
  auprc <- sum(diff(c(0, recall)) * precision)
  
  return(auprc)
}

evaluate_network <- function(score_mat, gold_adj) {
  
  idx <- upper.tri(score_mat)
  
  scores <- as.numeric(score_mat[idx])
  labels <- as.numeric(gold_adj[idx])
  labels[labels != 0] <- 1
  
  data.frame(
    AUROC = compute_auroc(labels, scores),
    AUPRC = compute_auprc(labels, scores)
  )
}
```

## 7. Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)

Generates structural distribution plots, library sizes, zero-inflation metrics, heatmaps, and PCA plots.

```{r eda}
run_eda <- function(x, dataset_name, eda_dir) {
  
  dir.create(eda_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  df_long <- reshape2::melt(x)
  colnames(df_long) <- c("Sample", "Taxon", "Count")
  
  p1 <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Count + 1)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
    scale_x_log10() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- count distribution"),
      x = "Count + 1, log10 scale",
      y = "Frequency"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(eda_dir, "count_distribution.png"), p1, width = 7, height = 5)
  
  sample_sums <- data.frame(
    Sample = rownames(x),
    LibrarySize = rowSums(x)
  )
  
  p2 <- ggplot(sample_sums, aes(x = Sample, y = LibrarySize)) +
    geom_col() +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank()) +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- library size per sample"),
      x = "Sample",
      y = "Total abundance"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(eda_dir, "library_size.png"), p2, width = 7, height = 5)
  
  zero_rate <- data.frame(
    Taxon = colnames(x),
    ZeroFraction = colMeans(x == 0)
  )
  
  p3 <- ggplot(zero_rate, aes(x = ZeroFraction)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- zero fraction per taxon"),
      x = "Fraction of zeros",
      y = "Number of taxa"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(eda_dir, "zero_fraction.png"), p3, width = 7, height = 5)
  
  top_taxa <- names(sort(colSums(x), decreasing = TRUE))[1:min(30, ncol(x))]
  x_top <- x[, top_taxa, drop = FALSE]
  
  png(file.path(eda_dir, "heatmap_top_taxa.png"), width = 900, height = 700)
  pheatmap(
    log1p(x_top),
    scale = "column",
    main = paste(dataset_name, "- top taxa heatmap")
  )
  dev.off()
  
  pca <- prcomp(log1p(x), scale. = TRUE)
  
  pca_df <- data.frame(
    PC1 = pca$x[, 1],
    PC2 = pca$x[, 2]
  )
  
  p4 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- PCA after log1p"),
      x = "PC1",
      y = "PC2"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(eda_dir, "pca_log1p.png"), p4, width = 7, height = 5)
}
```

## 8. Gold Standard Benchmarking

Loops through the 10 training datasets, tests combinations of preprocessing and modeling, and logs metrics.

```{r benchmark-loop}
all_metrics <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  
  dataset_name <- paste0("dataset_", i)
  
  message("\n==============================")
  message("Benchmarking ", dataset_name)
  message("==============================")
  
  dataset_dir <- file.path(test_dir, dataset_name)
  count_path <- file.path(dataset_dir, "count_table.csv")
  adj_path <- file.path(dataset_dir, "adj.csv")
  
  dataset_out <- file.path(out_dir, dataset_name)
  eda_dir <- file.path(dataset_out, "EDA")
  
  dir.create(dataset_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  x_raw <- read_count_table(count_path)
  taxa_names <- colnames(x_raw)
  
  gold_adj <- read_adj_matrix(adj_path, taxa_names)
  
  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      dataset = dataset_name,
      n_samples = nrow(x_raw),
      n_taxa = ncol(x_raw),
      zero_fraction = mean(x_raw == 0),
      mean_library_size = mean(rowSums(x_raw)),
      median_library_size = median(rowSums(x_raw)),
      gold_edge_density = sum(gold_adj[upper.tri(gold_adj)]) / length(gold_adj[upper.tri(gold_adj)])
    ),
    file.path(dataset_out, "dataset_summary.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  run_eda(x_raw, dataset_name, eda_dir)
  
  preprocessing_list <- list(
    raw_log  = log_transform(x_raw),
    tss_log  = log_transform(total_sum_scaling(x_raw)),
    zero_clr = clr_transform(zero_imputation_simple(x_raw))
  )
  
  model_results <- list()
  
  for (prep_name in names(preprocessing_list)) {
    
    x <- preprocessing_list[[prep_name]]
    
    models <- list(
      pearson = make_correlation_network(x, method = "pearson"),
      spearman = make_correlation_network(x, method = "spearman"),
      precision_ridge = make_precision_network(x)
    )
    
    for (model_name in names(models)) {
      
      method_id <- paste(prep_name, model_name, sep = "__")
      
      score_mat <- models[[model_name]]
      rownames(score_mat) <- taxa_names
      colnames(score_mat) <- taxa_names
      
      write.csv(
        score_mat,
        file.path(dataset_out, paste0("score_", method_id, ".csv"))
      )
      
      pred_adj <- threshold_top_edges(score_mat, edge_density = 0.05)
      
      write.csv(
        pred_adj,
        file.path(dataset_out, paste0("adjacency_", method_id, "_top5pct.csv"))
      )
      
      ev <- evaluate_network(score_mat, gold_adj)
      ev$Dataset <- dataset_name
      ev$Method <- method_id
      
      all_metrics[[paste(dataset_name, method_id, sep = "__")]] <- ev
      model_results[[method_id]] <- score_mat
    }
  }
  
  metrics_df <- bind_rows(all_metrics) %>%
    filter(Dataset == dataset_name) %>%
    arrange(desc(AUPRC), desc(AUROC))
  
  write.csv(
    metrics_df,
    file.path(dataset_out, "benchmark_metrics.csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  best_method <- metrics_df$Method[1]
  best_score <- model_results[[best_method]]
  final_adj <- threshold_top_edges(best_score, edge_density = 0.05)
  
  write.csv(
    final_adj,
    file.path(dataset_out, "FINAL_adjacency_matrix.csv")
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(metrics_df, aes(x = reorder(Method, AUPRC), y = AUPRC)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = paste(dataset_name, "- model benchmark"),
      x = "Method",
      y = "AUPRC"
    )
  
  ggsave(file.path(dataset_out, "benchmark_AUPRC.png"), p, width = 8, height = 5)
  
  png(file.path(dataset_out, "final_adjacency_heatmap.png"), width = 900, height = 700)
  pheatmap(
    final_adj,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    main = paste(dataset_name, "- final inferred adjacency")
  )
  dev.off()
}
```


```{R global metrics}

global_metrics <- bind_rows(all_metrics) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUPRC), desc(AUROC))

write.csv(
  global_metrics,
  file.path(out_dir, "GLOBAL_benchmark_metrics.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

method_summary <- global_metrics %>%
  group_by(Method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_AUPRC = mean(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_AUPRC = median(AUPRC, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_AUROC = mean(AUROC, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_AUROC = median(AUROC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_AUPRC), desc(mean_AUROC))

write.csv(
  method_summary,
  file.path(out_dir, "GLOBAL_method_summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_global <- ggplot(global_metrics, aes(x = Method, y = AUPRC)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Global benchmark across metagenomics datasets",
    x = "Method",
    y = "AUPRC"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(out_dir, "GLOBAL_benchmark_AUPRC.png"),
  p_global,
  width = 9,
  height = 6
)
```

```{R best method}

best_global_method <- method_summary$Method[1]

message("\nBest global method selected: ", best_global_method)

apply_selected_method <- function(x_raw, method_id) {
  
  parts <- strsplit(method_id, "__")[[1]]
  prep_name <- parts[1]
  model_name <- parts[2]
  
  if (prep_name == "raw_log") {
    x <- log_transform(x_raw)
  } else if (prep_name == "tss_log") {
    x <- log_transform(total_sum_scaling(x_raw))
  } else if (prep_name == "zero_clr") {
    x <- clr_transform(zero_imputation_simple(x_raw))
  } else {
    stop("Unknown preprocessing method.")
  }
  
  if (model_name == "pearson") {
    score <- make_correlation_network(x, method = "pearson")
  } else if (model_name == "spearman") {
    score <- make_correlation_network(x, method = "spearman")
  } else if (model_name == "precision_ridge") {
    score <- make_precision_network(x)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown network inference model.")
  }
  
  rownames(score) <- colnames(x_raw)
  colnames(score) <- colnames(x_raw)
  
  return(score)
}
```

```{R prediction on validation dataset}
for (i in 1:3) {
  
  dataset_name <- paste0("Dataset", i)
  
  message("\n==============================")
  message("Predicting validation ", dataset_name)
  message("==============================")
  
  dataset_dir <- file.path(validation_dir, dataset_name)
  count_path <- file.path(dataset_dir, "count_table.csv")
  
  dataset_out <- file.path(validation_out_dir, dataset_name)
  dir.create(dataset_out, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  x_raw <- read_count_table(count_path)
  taxa_names <- colnames(x_raw)
  
  score_mat <- apply_selected_method(x_raw, best_global_method)
  
  final_adj <- threshold_top_edges(score_mat, edge_density = 0.05)
  
  rownames(final_adj) <- taxa_names
  colnames(final_adj) <- taxa_names
  
  write.csv(
    score_mat,
    file.path(dataset_out, "predicted_score_matrix.csv")
  )
  
  write.csv(
    final_adj,
    file.path(dataset_out, "predicted_adjacency_matrix.csv")
  )
  
  write.table(
    final_adj,
    file.path(dataset_out, "predicted_adjacency_matrix.tsv"),
    sep = "\t",
    quote = FALSE,
    col.names = NA
  )
  
  png(file.path(dataset_out, "predicted_adjacency_heatmap.png"), width = 900, height = 700)
  pheatmap(
    final_adj,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    main = paste("Validation", dataset_name, "- predicted adjacency")
  )
  dev.off()
}
```
